intro: (EXAMPLE CAMPAIGN — PLACEHOLDER PROSE) The Hollow Lantern stands where the road meets the salt marsh. Its lamp has been dark for three nights, and the keeper has stopped asking travellers to stay.
(EXAMPLE CAMPAIGN) You have agreed to keep the light until dawn: read the notice, speak with Ivy, and make sure nothing comes up out of the cistern.
(PLACEHOLDER) This is a small demonstration campaign built entirely from content files. The prose and art are stand-ins.
defeat: The cold water closes over the yard. Above, the lamp stays dark.
(This is a defeat state. Load a save or begin again.)
victory: (EXAMPLE) Before dawn, the wick catches. The light goes out across the marsh in a long, steady sweep.
(The example objective is complete. You can keep exploring, inspect your party, or save.)
